answer: The admission bond is time locked for 9 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are logged in vertex, expire in comet, and inlet lists each expiry. An adversary running 175 aliases hence needs 161 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 1335 identities would post 2277 proofs and burn roughly 22 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
